title: Scripture and Sanctification
definition: Scripture and Sanctification means God uses His Word to make believers holy and conform them more to Christ.
summary: Scripture and Sanctification means God uses His Word to make believers holy and conform them more to Christ.
christFocus: Jesus sanctifies His people by truth, and the Holy Spirit uses Scripture to transform their desires, thoughts, and actions.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Sanctification is the Spirit’s work of making believers more like Christ. Scripture is one of the primary means God uses in that work. The Word teaches truth, exposes sin, renews the mind, and trains believers in righteousness.

God’s Word does not merely inform holiness; it forms holiness. As believers hear, believe, meditate on, and obey Scripture, the Holy Spirit reshapes what they love, hate, desire, and pursue.

Christ is both the goal and the source of sanctification. Believers are not trying to become holy apart from Him. They are being conformed to the Savior who loved them, cleansed them, and dwells with them by His Spirit.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many people want change but look only to willpower, shame, or self-improvement. Scripture and sanctification shows that lasting transformation comes through truth applied by the Holy Spirit.

This doctrine gives hope to slow growth. Sanctification may be gradual, but God’s Word is not weak. Christ continues His work in His people.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Submit your growth to God’s Word. Ask the Holy Spirit to use Scripture to expose sin, renew your mind, strengthen obedience, and make your daily life look more like Christ.
